Discovery brief: CSV export for the reports page.

Goal: let users download a report as a CSV file.

Item: One cohesive feature — add a 'Download CSV' button to the existing reports page that streams the currently-filtered report rows as a CSV. It is a single deliverable: the button, the export endpoint, and the CSV serialisation are one ticket's worth of tightly-coupled work on the reports surface.

question: Shape this brief into a sensible set of tickets — one one-line gloss per ticket boundary.
